description:
## Goal

Make the boxed apply seam's return convention coherent when a construction-wrapper member returns a capture-free function reference or lambda and that same member already has a non-bottom, callable-only return demand. The wrapper and every boxed caller must agree on one public return word without coarsening unrelated destination-passing returns.

## Current state

At origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`, `RuntimeDemand::is_ignore()` is true only when both the shape axis is ignored and the callable axis is empty. The seam bootstrap in `settle_demand_cone` therefore raises only bottom contributions. A member whose joined return contribution is `shape=Ignore` plus a non-empty exact callable axis is non-bottom and is not bootstrapped, even when it stands behind a construction wrapper.

A capture-free exact callable reserves zero private ABI lanes. In the affected mixed-provenance case, the member can therefore publish an `Absent` return while a boxed callsite uses the seam's one-word `ValueRef` delivery. `verify_boxed_apply_seam_return_convention` correctly refuses that mismatch at packaging; the verifier is a backstop, not the repair.

The population is narrower than "any first-class callable returning a zero-capture callable." A boxed-only member with no visible contributor still bootstraps to whole and is green. A grounded sibling at a different activation key also does not trigger it. The failing witness must prove that the callable-only contribution lands on the exact executable that is also a wrapper member.

## Signal and strategy

1. Recover or replace the untracked fp1/fp5/r5 probes with the smallest checked-in production-path fixture that demonstrates the same executable key has both (a) first-class wrapper membership and (b) a joined return demand with ignored shape and a non-empty exact callable axis.
2. Pin pre-fix behavior at both boundaries: demand/transport telemetry shows the member's zero-lane return and wrapper `Absent`; packaging reports the boxed-apply return-convention refusal. Run interp, JIT, and AOT.
3. Add a capture-free fnref case, a capture-free lambda case, and a capturing-return control. Also keep boxed-only and different-activation grounded-sibling controls green.
4. Work backward from the one public seam contract. Do not weaken/remove `verify_boxed_apply_seam_return_convention`, and do not use `shape.is_ignore() && !callable.is_first_class()` as the bootstrap predicate: whole shape alone still leaves an exact capture-free callable at zero private lanes.
5. Repair the demand/representation model so a callable returned across the boxed seam is itself represented in the public boxed carrier when needed, while exact direct-only callable returns remain zero-lane and destination-passing field layouts remain precise.

## Acceptance

- The new minimal fnref and lambda witnesses compile and produce the expected value through interp, JIT, and AOT.
- Producer wrapper return form and boxed callsite delivery agree by construction; the existing verifier remains enabled and passes.
- Capture-free direct-only callable returns remain zero-lane.
- Capturing callable-return, boxed-only, different-activation, and destination-passing controls do not regress.
- Add the behavior fixture(s) and focused demand/transport contract test; update `.agent/docs/pipeline.md` to remove the residual `Absent` paragraph once the state is no longer reachable.
- Run focused tests, full lib and fixture matrix, `cargo fmt --check`, and clippy with warnings denied.
title: A boxed-seam member with a callable-only return contribution can publish zero lanes against a one-word caller
